newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-BREWERS 1B JAHA UNDERGOES SHOULDER SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-BREWERS 1B JAHA UNDERGOES SHOULDER SURGERY.

text.p: Milwaukee Brewers first baseman John Jaha will be sidelined indefinitely after undergoing successful surgery to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder on Tuesday, the team announced.
The 31-year-old Jaha, who has not played since May 31, is hitting .247 with 11 homers and 26 RBI in 46 games. He was coming off a career season in which he batted .300 with 34 homers and 118 RBI.
Milwaukee, which is 6-9 since Jaha went out of the lineup, is third in the American League Central Division with a 31-34 record, 3 1/2 games behind first-place Cleveland.
